# 2 Chronicles Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-was-completed all the-work that made Solomon for-house-of YHWH and-he-brought Solomon the-holy-things-of David his-father and-the-silver and-the-gold and-all the-vessels he-put in-treasuries-of house-of God.

**2** Then assembled Solomon the-elders-of Israel and-all heads-of the-tribes leaders-of the-fathers of-sons-of Israel to Jerusalem to-bring-up ark-of covenant-of YHWH from-city-of David which is Zion.

**3** And-they-assembled to the-king all men-of Israel in-the-feast which is the-month the-seventh.

**4** And-they-came all elders-of Israel and-they-carried the-Levites the-ark.

**5** And-they-brought-up the-ark and-tent-of meeting and-all vessels-of the-holiness that were-in the-tent brought-them-up the-priests the-Levites.

**6** And-the-king Solomon and-all congregation-of Israel the-assembled to-him before the-ark sacrificing sheep and-cattle that not could-be-numbered and-not could-be-counted from-abundance.

**7** And-they-brought the-priests ark-of covenant-of YHWH to its-place to-the-inner-sanctuary-of the-house to-the-holy-of holies to under wings-of the-cherubim.

**8** And-the-cherubim were spreading wings over place-of the-ark and-they-covered the-cherubim over the-ark and-over its-poles from-above.

**9** And-they-extended the-poles and-they-were-seen the-heads-of the-poles from the-ark on the-face-of the-inner-sanctuary and-not they-were-seen to-the-outside and-it-is there to this day.

**10** Nothing was in-the-ark except the-two tablets that put Moses at-Horeb where made YHWH a-covenant with sons-of Israel in-their-coming-out from-Egypt.

**11** And-it-was in-coming-out the-priests from the-holy-place for all the-priests who-were-found had-consecrated-themselves without-regard-to divisions

**12** and-the-Levites the-singers all-of-them to-Asaph to-Heman to-Jeduthun and-to-their-sons and-to-their-brothers clothed-in fine-linen with-cymbals and-with-harps and-lyres standing east-of the-altar and-with-them priests a-hundred-and-twenty blowing trumpets

**13** and-it-was as-one for-the-trumpeters and-for-the-singers to-make-heard one sound to-praise and-to-thank YHWH and-as-they-lifted-up the-sound with-trumpets and-with-cymbals and-with-instruments-of song and-in-praising YHWH for He-is-good for forever His-lovingkindness and-the-house was-filled with-a-cloud house-of YHWH

**14** and-not could the-priests to-stand to-minister because-of the-cloud for filled glory-of YHWH house-of God.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **5:10**: except the-two tablets — By Solomon's time, the ark contained only the covenant tablets. The jar of manna and Aaron's rod (cf. Hebrews 9:4) were evidently lost.

- **5:13**: for He-is-good for forever His-lovingkindness — This liturgical refrain (ki tov ki le'olam chasdo) appears throughout Chronicles and Psalms as Israel's core confession of faith.

- **5:14**: glory-of YHWH filled — The kavod (glory) filling the temple parallels the glory filling the tabernacle at Sinai (Exodus 40:34-35). Solomon's temple receives the same divine validation.


— EMET
